notes.title: Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Hello Players!
This is our first summer sale!
Now you can buy Chief's Quest with 50% discount.

We will be very happy if you'll support us.

After this sale, we will make a small announcement.
[u]Thank you everyone for keeping interest in Chief's Quest![/u]

[*] backgrounds

[*] hud

notes.title: Bugfix and Background changes
notes.notes:
[b]Hello![/b]

[url=https://twitter.com/GreatChiefGames][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33707604/ff6a998ad63cdd9544d8984d3e9b5286ada02f85.gif[/img][/url]

[b]So:[/b]
[list]
[*] Change BG in the 3rd level (dangerous shine and spiders lair)

notes.title: UPDATE! (finally)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33707604/77d96b914475ad6c4b98fe223a2062e4cb508fd7.jpg[/img]


[b]Hello players![/b]
sorry for the long absence!
It was a harsh spring for us, but we got back to business.

 [b]So what do we have:[/b]
[list]
[*]  3rd level with 2 different "biomes" and new type of traps
[*]  Magnificent boss(with lot of animations)
[*]  New enemies of course
[*]  + a little changes on previous levels.
[/list]


Also we added a level selection if you don't want to play now but want to see all locations
And we added a full recovery button, so press F4 if you have any troubles in your journey 
(it all will be removed with game release)

notes.title: Full second level released!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello players![/b]

This is our first update in this year!
We finally made up the second level and we hope you'll enjoy it!

[b]Whats New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Second Boss.
[*] 7 new locations.
[*] New Enemy
[*] Animated Backgrounds
[*] 1 new achievement.
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Also we did over 50 copies! 
[b]So thank you again for suporting our project![/b]

If you find any bugs or you have any suggestions for the game, please let us know.

notes.title: Almost 50 copies sold!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello players![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33707604/3f3b60aada0c2f777537a78c83826b03993fc3a8.gif[/img]

We want to share with you that 47 copies were sold, its not much, but its something. [u]THANK YOU[/u]

Also the next major update will be around next week and will include animated backgrounds.
This is the main reason why it took so much time (almost a month).

At the moment, animated backgrounds will be only in new locations, but over time it will appear in some old locations.

If you want to recive a little more news and other stuff about the game, please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/GreatChiefGames]twitter[/url]



Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The first Major Update(a half of it at least)
notes.notes:
[b]Hello players![/b]
[b]Thank you all for suporting our project![/b]

Sorry for being out of schedule, one of our pc has broken.
Because of it, this major update contain only the half of new level.
But also we added something new for the first level!


[b]So...what do we have here:[/b]
[list]
[*] New animation and pattern for the first boss.
[*] New NPC.
[*] New level with 13 locations.
[*] 3 New enemies.
[*] Replaced some animations (deathcloud was ugly).
[*] Now in some locations on level one you can easily see the secrets.
[*] 1 new achievement.
[*] All bugs that we (and you) has found - fixed 
[/list]

But there is one problem, due to changes in the structure of levels,[u] old saves doesn't work.[/u]
[u]So you'll need to start a new game.[/u]
I hope this never happens again, sorry!

[i]Have a wonderful holidays![/i]

notes.title: Hello, Thank you, and Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello 
First of all I just want to say: 
[b]Thanks, merci, გმადლობთ, 감사, danke![/b]
To all of you people who bought this game! 

Couple of days ago we have finally release our first game in early access.
And today we've got the first minor update that fix the hitboxes and make the first enemies a little bit easier...if you dont forget to grab a throwing knife of course.ːsteammockingː

Now we are working hard on the next level and it will be a much bigger than the first one and more diverse!
Also we are working on sound effects that is will be added to the game soon.

[b]Hope you liked our game and stay tuned for the next announcement![/b]
